author: Aurélien Pierre
name: Utility styles (Denoise, Pseudo-deconvolution)
description: Workflow-agnostic utility styles by Aurélien Pierre: a conservative profiled-denoise base style and three pseudo-deconvolution sharpening styles (5/7/9 px) simulating basic Richardson-Lucy deblurring. Recovered from dtstyle.net via Common Crawl.
